'''Troll mage commandos''' were a type of small troll that appeared to be disguised as a cow. They were found wandering around [[Burthorpe]] and [[Taverley]], with [[Troll commando]]s and [[Troll ranger commando]]s. They dropped the [[Spellstorm drape]]. Killing them could be a good way to make money for new players, because the trolls were quite weak and rarely hit.

They were replaced with [[White wolf (Burthorpe)|White wolves]], which have the same stats and drops.
